title: Ordinary inverse image respects horizontal coefficient maps
statement: Let l be prime, E/Q_l finite, and let f:X→Y be any scheme morphism. Use the native coefficient-sequence module categories and coefficient rings A_k=O_E/m_E^(k+1) [def-sp-varying-ring-operations, def-weil-compact-support-native-system-evaluation]. For n≤m, write τ_W:e_m^W→e_n^W⋙Res_W for the actual horizontal map [lem-weil-compact-support-coefficient-transition]. Let δ_k:G_f⋙e_k^X ≅ e_k^Y⋙G_{f,k} be the normalized native inverse-image evaluation comparison [def-sp-varying-ring-operations], and let g:Res_Y⋙G_{f,m}→G_{f,n}⋙Res_X be the inverse mate of the section-normalized direct-image scalar square, constructed in [lem-weil-compact-support-open-restriction-scalar]. Then for every ordinary coefficient system N on Y, τ_X,G_f(N) ≫ Res_X(δ_n,N) = δ_m,N ≫ G_{f,m}(τ_Y,N) ≫ g_(e_n^Y(N)). No cartesian or flatness assumption on N is required.

source.place: Tags 03DA and 03D3, naturality under adjunction of module inverse and direct images; Tag 0941, sequence-site horizontal maps. The first transpose in the assigned ordinary-open transition argument.

proof.text: Apply compactSupportOrdinaryDirectImageTransition, which states the equality of the two direct-image horizontal composites by their section maps.

Apply the generic horizontalLeftMate calculation to the system inverse-image/direct-image adjunction and the two single-level adjunctions. Its two evaluation-unit equations are the defining normalization of moduleEvalG. Its scalar unit equation is unit_mateEquiv_symm, since the scalar inverse-image comparison was defined as that inverse mate. Naturality of the horizontal transformation and injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence give the claimed square.
Use compactSupportOrdinaryPullbackUnit for the two evaluated system units in precisely the ordinary coefficient-system presentation.

theorem compactSupportOrdinaryPullbackTransition {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (N : coefficientSequenceModules.{u, u} l E Y) :
    (compactSupportOrdinaryCoefficientTransition l E X h).app
        ((ProEtale.VaryingRing.pull (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
          (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) f).obj N) ≫
      (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars X (compactSupportLevelQuotient l E m n h)).map
        ((ProEtale.VaryingRing.moduleEvalG (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
          (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) f n).hom.app N) =
    (ProEtale.VaryingRing.moduleEvalG (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
        (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) f m).hom.app N ≫
      (ProEtale.StrictTower.modulePullback (compactSupportSystemLevel l E m) f).map
        ((compactSupportOrdinaryCoefficientTransition l E Y h).app N) ≫
      (compactSupportScalarPullback f (compactSupportLevelQuotient l E m n h)).app
        ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).obj N)
